messages:
Lina: Noticed an inconsistency in the API ref for embeddings. Quickstart curl uses a bare array in -d and some SDK snippets show both shapes. Users are submitting raw arrays and getting 400s.

Omar: Which file/PR?

Lina: docs/reference/embeddings.md in PR #5102. Current curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '[\"one\",\"two\"]'
```
Should be object form for batch calls:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\"input\": [\"one\",\"two\"]}'
```

Jules: Yup saw reports in support. Also the generated Python snippet sometimes shows client.embeddings.create(["a","b"]) because the snippet generator picks the wrong example from OpenAPI. We should standardize the primary example to the object form and add a separate single-input example.

docs-bot: PR #5102  examples-lint  failed: example_request_shape mismatch in docs/reference/embeddings.md. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/5102/logs

Omar: Plan: Lina will update the docs page curl/codeblocks. Jules will patch openapi/examples to make object form canonical and regen snippets. I'll add a one-line migration note: "Note: batch embeddings expect {\"input\": [...] } — older examples showing raw arrays are deprecated."

Lina: I'll open a tiny PR for the docs quickfix with the curl and JS examples corrected and the migration note.

Jules: I will update specs/openapi/embeddings.yaml primary example and run the snippet generator. Also add a unit in examples-lint that rejects top-level arrays for POST /v1/embeddings.

Lina: Local preview looks good; curl returns 200 against staging when I used {"input": [...]} payload. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5110

docs-bot: PR #5110 opened by Lina  examples-lint pending.

Jules: OpenAPI PR coming up, will include the linter test.

Omar: Thanks all. Once both PRs merge, I'll update CHANGELOG and close the ticket.

Lina: PR merged and tracker updated. :white_check_mark:
